hypotheses.S1_objective_stability: Final off-diagonal energy has coefficient of variation below 0.05 across starts for both layers.
hypotheses.S2_layer0_axis_recovery: Layer-0 rotations have mean best-match absolute axis overlap at least 0.90 and mutual-nearest recovery at least 80%.
